scope: Local source, BFF, browser, accessibility, strict static checks, production build, secret scan, and production dependency audit evidence for the organization-blind restricted support console and the separate tenant-owner grant controls. Synthetic identities, identifiers, grants, and diagnostics only. No customer data, provider credential or request, source-system write, real support identity, real IdP/MFA enforcement, ticket-system integration, customer notification, protected staging, deployment, legal approval, compliance, or production-readiness claim is included.

diagnosticInputAuthority: exact organization UUID supplied through the authenticated ticket
exact grant UUID supplied through the authenticated ticket
supportBrowserBoundary.diagnosticOutput: fixed capped aggregate counts and timestamps only

allowedOperations.query: exactly organizationId UUID and grantId UUID

approvalRequires: bounded ticket reference without control characters
bounded audit-visible reason without control characters

allowed: copy or clear one-time request code
load one exact approved aggregate diagnostic result

supportAssertions: request creation submits only action and requested duration
the raw request code appears for transfer but neither browser storage area contains it
diagnostic lookup sends exactly the supplied organization and grant UUIDs
only the fixed aggregate ledger is rendered
rejected diagnostic authority uses one unavailable state
tenant approval sends explicit confirmation and clears the browser code
tenant revocation sends exact grant, reason, and confirmation
support and tenant grant surfaces pass automated accessibility scans

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The first focused browser pass expected both browser storage areas to be completely empty, but the authenticated session library legitimately created one unrelated session-storage entry.
verificationCorrections.correction: Assert the security invariant directly by examining every storage value and proving that neither storage area contains the one-time request code.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: All four support browser tests and both support accessibility scans pass.

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The first full repository gate stopped because eight changed source and documentation files were not in canonical Prettier form.
verificationCorrections.correction: Apply the pinned repository formatter to only the reported files and rerun the complete verification command from the beginning.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: Formatting, lint, typecheck, 527 tests, every validator, and the production build pass.

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The existing shared tenant mutation BFF parsed upstream JSON without a byte ceiling.
verificationCorrections.correction: Use the existing streaming bounded-response reader with a one MiB ceiling and add an oversized support-approval response negative test.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: The oversized response fails closed with a private 502, and the complete repository gate passes.

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: Final contract review found that client-side parsers discarded unknown upstream properties only after the complete payload had already reached the browser.
verificationCorrections.correction: Add strict success schemas to the organization-blind support BFF and tenant grant-list BFF, re-emit only whitelisted fields, minimize successful support-action responses, keep strict client validation, and add expanded-payload negative assertions.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: Expanded diagnostic or grant-list payloads fail closed before browser delivery; 21 focused BFF tests, 42 Chromium tests, and the complete repository gate pass.

knownLimitations: No real IdP group, acr mapping, MFA challenge, bypass negative, recovery flow, or support offboarding was exercised.
The ticket reference is supplied by the approving owner and is not validated against a ticket system.
No customer notification or grant-use notification workflow exists.

The one-time code is necessarily visible in the DOM during transfer; clipboard history, screenshots, browser extensions, endpoint compromise, and screen sharing are outside this local application proof.
The 12-hex support identity reference is display-only; authorization uses the full keyed digest.
Expired unclaimed request rows are retained because no approved purge policy exists.
HMAC-key rotation has no overlap window; the documented procedure disables access, revokes or drains grants, waits the maximum lifetime, then rotates.
Multi-replica key consistency, response timing, periodic access review, incident response, protected staging, and production alerting are unverified.
conclusion: The organization-blind support console and separate tenant-owner grant controls pass their checked-in local acceptance surface without expanding the ADR 0053 diagnostic authority. This is local technical evidence only. Goal 1 remains active and restricted support must not be enabled in production until the stated identity, ticketing, notification, endpoint, access-review, rotation, incident, timing, and protected-staging gates are satisfied.
